FOREMAN (MOTOR CAR GARAGE) RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2024
NOTICE
No.- 05 /R&A Dated: 27th January, 2026
Vide Court’s Notice No. 91/R&A Cell dated 03rd December, 2025, the final result of Foreman
(Motor Car Garage) Recruitment Examination, 2024 was published in which only 01(one) candidate namely
Sri Ravi Ranjan Kumar (Roll No. PF24010004) was selected under UR category. However, the said candidate
has concealed/ suppressed information regarding his present government employment in online application
form as well as during the stage of document verification/interview. Later on, after issuance of appointment
letter, he has declared information regarding his present employment.
Due to aforementioned concealment/ suppression by Sri Ravi Ranjan Kumar (Roll No. PF24010004),
the Hon’ble Court have been pleased to cancel his selection/appointment in light of Clause No. 12(xii),
12(xiii) and 12(xiv) of Advertisement No. PHC/03/2024 dated 28.05.2024 issued for Foreman (Motor Car
Garage) Recruitment Examination, 2024.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General I/c
